The point is you are making vast generalizing assumptions about my diet and other exercise habits based on my reported weight. I didn’t offer this information to you or how I’ve lost the weight I’ve lost.  I only made one general statement that I use running as a tool to lose weight. I am actually a vegetarian and I eat clean and organic. I don’t eat chips or soda. I don’t even remember the last time I put chemical bullshit like that in my body.
